# Status Code Property

The [`http.Response`](https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#Response) struct has a `.StatusCode` property that contains the status code of the response.

## Assignment

Update the `getUserCode` function to return the status code of the response.

_You should get a `404` response when requesting a user that doesn't exist!_
